name: Sahasra Electronic Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in February 2013, Sahasra Electronic Solutions Limited is an Electronic System Design and Manufacturing company that provides electronic system design and manufacturing.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Sahasra is an Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) company with integrated capabilities across the entire ESDM value chain — from design, prototyping, sample batching, mass production, to lifecycle management.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.60 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.64 Cr.
